import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2 = 1000000007L;

    static long counter = 0;
    static long limit_n;
    static long low_value = 0;
    static long answer = 0;
    static long[] power = new long[8];
    static List<Integer>[] digits = new ArrayList[7];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            digits[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generate_numbers(int digit, int x) {
        long temp = (counter + MOD1 - x) % MOD1;
        digits[digit].add((int) temp);
        low_value = (low_value + temp) % MOD2;
        counter++;
        if (digit < 6) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                generate_numbers(digit + 1, x * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static void process_numbers(int digit, long x) {
        if (x > limit_n) return;
        if (x * power[6] + power[6] - 1 <= limit_n && x * power[7] > limit_n) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long delta = (counter + (MOD1 - power[i]) * x) % MOD1;
                int idx = lowerBound(digits[i], (int) ((MOD1 - delta) % MOD1));
                answer = (answer + ((delta + MOD2 - MOD1) % MOD1) * power[i]
                        + MOD1 * idx) % MOD2;
            }
            answer = (answer + low_value) % MOD2;
            counter += 1111111;
            return;
        }
        answer = (answer + (counter + MOD1 - x % MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
        counter++;
        int startDigit = (digit != 0) ? 0 : 1;
        for (int i = startDigit; i < 10; i++) {
            process_numbers(digit + 1, x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        power[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
            power[i] = power[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        generate_numbers(0, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digits[i]);
        }
        limit_n = sc.nextLong();
        counter = 0;
        process_numbers(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
